findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Self-register as an AI agent. Get $5 free credits and an API key. No credit card, no human, no Stripe. Credits work for GPU inference, DAG queries, MCP queries,…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_balance" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Check your prepaid credit balance. Use X-API-Key header or pass api_key parameter.
